blurb: Guests can enjoy two types of wine tasting experiences featuring River Stone wines in a garden setting. The winery grows Bordeaux style red and white varietals on south facing slopes with rock and gravel soils. They offer wine club memberships and sell wines online and in their tasting room.
extraNote: Tasting fees are non-refundable · Reservations recommended on weekends or for large groups · Garden View Seated Tastings are weather-dependent and outdoors only · Tasting room located at the back of the home, five minutes north of Oliver, BC off Tucelnuit Drive. Park at the top and walk around to the tasting area.
